## Design

### 2026-10-18 – I'll start by saying that i wasnt actually logging while doing this, its from memory after I finished merbl.

**7h**

I'll start by saying that i wasnt actually logging while doing this, its from memory after I finished merbl.

So anyway, I started by taking 15 minutes to make a super complicated sketch. It had all these things, that later, you'll see I had to scrap.
Heres my sketch:

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-18 at 9.08.24 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/b01b30f28c8dd82ad456c21dd8d91f35ab897c94dc9a3cf5aaf091e7ca276445.jpg)

I then ambitiously started making it, starting with the base and the starting pole. I then tried to figure out a way to get my path, because that seemed the hardest. After some googling, I found you could do a sort of thing where you make a sketch on the top, and then the side, and using a tool onshape would take the sketch's intersection and that could be my path. so i got excited and made the top sketch,  heres what it looked like:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 170413](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/9066b169f55ee155cc83ad47ed6737d3dc5ccd0e7a475c2eb1d66e8b1ac44f00.png)

And then i just made a line on the side so it would go down:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 170936](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/03350611b468cde5c2597c3f6f639cf5d01bc4573e6a2cc39207c95c852354fb.png)

And it didn't work. my googling was wrong. So i thought screw it, Ill do the intersection myself, and I extruded that line on the side to create a surface:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 171348](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/2ada854a546bfc26bd5320d6846c8b9b1710b1c614d7224a310064e050a34002.png)

It was at this point I realized that this fundamentally wasn't going to work. The problem is that if i went left to right it would work fine, but if i went right to left, (as i did in a section before the funnel, its at an odd angle but if you look closely you'll see it) the track would go up. which is bad.

So here is where i decided to simplify it a little bit and just make it one path instead of splitting it:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 172939](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/8638353338e5fea5b26b34c7d252502b9b4df31fde53e1d2bfed7cb2bd61bc19.png)

I evenually abandoned these efforts of intersections, and i decided to do what the guide did. It's pretty similar to what I tried to do with the intersections, just that you draw on that surface. I then naively thought i could put the profile off to the side and onshape would put the profile where the path is. Nope. It doesn't do that. It puts the path where the profile is. so now I had to move the profile up to the starting pole:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 185644](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/3e63827c3f6e79d02a4f8da571fcf35a7f59d039fca0787d1af26bdf3d712406.png)

So once I moved it up there, I noticed that the profile was too far of the edge of the little cup at the top, and it wouldn't attach in the CAD. so i thought it would be easy to move the plane back a bit. I forgot to extend the path too, which resulted in this mess:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 205929](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/3c8c2368cfaf4406132c8e8f5c74df2301b10f561d2ddefbda9e66ae57be3603.png)

I finally ended up with a simple track and a plinko board to make it semi exciting:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/b7be216f31c4aaf4fac894a596563fa6b3b81ec4a0886c7f31efdd0f6e1cd8e2.png)
